_comment: Copy this file, fill in your own paths, and pass it to each step. Paths are relative to the folder that holds pipeline/ unless absolute.

hero._note: find the codename with: Source2Viewer-CLI -i pak01_dir.vpk --vpk_list | grep models/heroes

character.name: my_character
character._parts_note: bodygroup = the source DMX path SourceIO names each compiled mesh after. replace_with swaps that mesh for a source DMX; add_dmx adds a part the compiled model doesn't have.
